_note: BOARD SPACE TEST BS1: missionboard26a (Jessica's) WITHOUT ITS SPEECH, on the new boardspace template (his MB01a whole: its orbit pick,
its scripts, its map marker on the accept). Her prose, object and objective verbatim; the speaker, broadcast, say and message are left out
because the template builds none yet, and her recipe keeps them for build two.
Reading it: taken from the board, the system objective shows, arriving in the system swaps to the repair objective, using the satellite pays.
Any fault is a board or orbit fault, not a speech one. Unbuilt once 26a builds.
